scope.description: Installed Zed 10x external-agent discovery, launch, reconnect, failure classification, and cleanup for Mac-local and Mac-to-Intrepid projects

stack.framework: GPUI desktop application with protobuf remote transport and ACP subprocesses

components.role: Publishes the remote server's external-agent inventory
Registers remote entity handlers during project construction
Exercises a settings update after the remote handler is ready

architecture.observedRace: The server uses a one-second delay and a one-way ExternalAgentsUpdated message. If the client handler is registered later, the initial inventory is lost and is not requested or replayed.

requirements.text: Every supported installed-product surface exposes the host-valid external-agent inventory after a cold project open.
A selected agent launches on the project execution host and can read exact project bytes through an ACP tool call.
Reconnect and settings refresh converge idempotently without relying on startup timing.
Missing executable, authentication, capacity, and timeout failures are classified without a false success.
Agent and transport processes terminate without residue when a session completes or times out.

productSurfaces.name: Installed Zed 10x with a Mac-local project
Installed Zed 10x on Mac with an Intrepid remote project
productSurfaces.supportedInventory: two Linux-local plus seven persistent Intrepid routes

criticalJourneys.name: Cold open publishes the complete host-valid inventory
criticalJourneys.terminalObservable: Agent inventory is present without waiting for an unrelated settings change

criticalJourneys.name: Launch an agent and read exact project bytes with a tool
criticalJourneys.terminalObservable: ACP completes a tool call from the real project cwd and returns the expected sentinel

criticalJourneys.name: Settings changes converge to one current inventory
criticalJourneys.terminalObservable: Added and removed routes are reflected exactly once

criticalJourneys.name: Reconnect restores inventory and launchability
criticalJourneys.terminalObservable: A new transport session receives a current snapshot and can launch a route

criticalJourneys.name: Expected route failures remain explicit
criticalJourneys.terminalObservable: Missing executable, authentication, capacity, and timeout outcomes are classified as failures

criticalJourneys.name: Completion and timeout leave no owned process residue
criticalJourneys.terminalObservable: The agent process group and transport session are terminal

screens.name: Agent Panel external-agent picker and thread

direct: Settings projection and host-affinity unit tests
Remote settings update after handler registration
Host-command ACP canary for selected routes
gaps: No production-shaped cold-open ordering where inventory exists before handler registration
No installed Zed client-to-remote-server journey in the prior live canary
No release-blocking assertion against an unhandled ExternalAgentsUpdated message

knownDefects.evidence: Zed-10x.log recorded client:unhandled remote message name:ExternalAgentsUpdated before the Linux process attempted a stale Mac launcher path
.vibe/zed-acp-live-canary.py launches route commands directly and never starts Zed or crosses its remote transport
